headline: Approved public accessibility revisions to the rules of procedure by a 6-0 vote.
summary: Members discussed the draft annual report and a Maintenance of Net Operating Income application, and no motions were made on either item. Members approved changes to the rules of procedure on public accessibility by a 6-0 vote.
decisions: Approved changes to the rules of procedure, as drafted by Council, by a 6-0 vote.

decision_evidence.quote: 0:28:17 - Matthew Lax moves to accept the changes to the Rent Board Rules of Procedure as drafted by Council. Seconded by Anne-Laure Razat. (6-0) The motion passes.
